name: Temporal RGB Ghost
description: Per-channel temporal displacement: R=current, G=N frames ago, B=M frames ago. Moving objects leave vivid rainbow comet tails as each color channel trails a different distance behind. Static areas appear normal. The blue trail now integrates every frame between the two delays into a continuous comet streak, displacement only shimmers where something moved, and the G delay glides between frames. Like a tube camera, bright highlights lag longer and leave stronger comets than dark objects, every ghost channel discharges back to the live picture so static areas stay untouched, and holding the pointer pulls the ghosts into register inside a lens at the cursor.
